quarterly_data.quarter: Formosa Advanced Technologies IR presentation: MOPS 813120260611E001 (06-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D plan (June deck): Bump and RDL - new equipment expected to be installed and qualified in Q2, with initial customer validation completed in Q4; combined with 3D TSV, the company plans to offer a full turnkey service covering Bump, RDL and overmold packaging by Q1 2027. It has developed the 3D TSV copper-revealed process (BVR) and 2-die stacked overmold packaging, with pilot production expected to begin in the third quarter; 4-die stacked overmold packaging is under verification and expected to complete development in the fourth quarter. The technology will be applied to high-capacity, high-speed DDR5 R-DIMM server memory modules.
quarterly_data.figure: turnkey Bump / RDL / overmold service by Q1 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Formosa Advanced Technologies IR presentation: MOPS 813120260611E001 (06-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business overview (June deck): the company has already increased output from existing facilities by upgrading bottleneck equipment and plans long term to replace aging equipment and expand capacity within current factory sites. Plant 5 utilities and cleanroom construction was completed in Q2 2026; advanced packaging equipment installation and qualification are underway, with pilot production expected to begin in Q4. It will keep adjusting capex and expanding capacity according to customer demand. Market outlook (company): strong HBM demand has led major international DRAM makers to prioritise HBM, causing a shortage of conventional DRAM and growth opportunities for Taiwanese DDR4 makers, which are expanding DDR4 capacity and output while packaging and testing outsourcing demand grows with them; server and industrial-control module demand remains strong while end-consumer demand weakened on higher DRAM prices.
